title: Using Cursor to Accelerate Migration to Swift Testing
summary: DoorDash’s iOS platform team encoded a repeatable XCTest-to-Swift-Testing migration in Cursor rules, connected build and test commands through SweetPad and MCP, and kept module ownership with individual teams. Reliability gates, including repeated clean runs, turned a broad migration into bounded work that agents could verify.
takeaway: Pilot one module with a repo rule that maps XCTest APIs to Swift Testing, includes the exact build/test commands, and requires three clean runs. Let the module owner review behavior before rolling it out.
